<div class="card">
  <h3 class="project-card-title">macOSMoveTo <span class="badge">Shipped</span></h3>
  <p class="project-card-body">Finder has no native "Move to…" Quick Action — moving a file means drag-and-drop or clipboard workarounds. Identified the workflow gap; designed, packaged, tested, and documented the utility.</p>
  <p class="project-card-body"><strong>Stack:</strong> Automator, AppleScript.</p>
  <p class="project-card-links">
    <a class="btn btn-sm" href="https://github.com/colerehbein/macOSMoveTo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source &amp; install guide</a>
  </p>
</div>

<div class="card">
  <h3 class="project-card-title">Thesis Analysis Workflow <span class="badge">In preparation</span></h3>
  <p class="project-card-body">Reproducible longitudinal psychometric analysis and automated reporting for the master's thesis (mindfulness-based behavioral activation for depression) — every table and figure regenerates from data, with no hand-edited numbers. Sole analyst: data collection, cleaning, psychometrics, longitudinal analysis, automated reporting.</p>
  <p class="project-card-body"><strong>Stack:</strong> R, Quarto.</p>
  <p class="project-card-body"><em>Public synthetic/de-identified demo in preparation — no participant data will ever be published.</em></p>
</div>

<div class="card">
  <h3 class="project-card-title">pandoc-apa7 <span class="badge">Archived</span></h3>
  <p class="project-card-body">Draft academic manuscripts in Markdown and compile to APA 7th-edition LaTeX/PDF — an APA writing workflow without Word. Experimental fork: updated an open-source APA6 pandoc template for APA 7. Work-in-progress experiment, last touched 2022; kept public for reference.</p>
  <p class="project-card-body"><strong>Stack:</strong> pandoc, LaTeX (apa7 class), BibLaTeX.</p>
  <p class="project-card-links">
    <a class="btn btn-sm" href="https://github.com/colerehbein/pandoc-apa7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source</a>
  </p>
</div>
